name: Dot Voting / Heatmapping
deliverable: Visual distribution of group attention across ideas without groupthink

steps.text: Give each person five dots. Explain that all five may go on one idea or be spread across many.
Have everyone write their choices privately before approaching the wall, so no one follows a cursor.
Walk the wall in silence, place dots on the ideas themselves, and keep comments and gestures to yourself.
Step back and circle the three densest clusters, not the cards with the loudest advocates.
Invite those authors to explain the mechanism in one minute each, then open the discussion.

failure: Bandwagon voting: people wait for leadership to place dots, then pile onto the same cards, so heat measures hierarchy.
intervention: Stop the wall, have everyone write choices on paper first, and hide cursors or dot counts until the timer ends.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in facilitation practice; no single documented originator.
